explication: Onyx is a music-game authoring toolkit: creators provide song/chart sources, the toolkit transforms them, packages game-specific assets, and produces playable or distributable results. Native utilities cover audio codecs, encryption, archives, and platform formats. The browser player previews generated songs, while the website compiler publishes catalog metadata. Several Haskell orchestration modules are absent from the sample, so those central control-flow links are represented only where README or sampled code supports them.
